# Interactions

Here is the equation for a fitted model on the `penguins` data, with bill length as the response, and an interaction between body mass and species:

\begin{align*}
\widehat{\text{bill length}} &= 26.99 + 5.18 \ \text{IsChinstrap} - 0.26 \ \text{IsGentoo}  + 0.0032 \ \text{body mass} \\
& \hspace{0.5cm} + 0.0013 \ \text{body mass} \cdot \text{IsChinstrap} + 0.0010 \ \text{body mass} \cdot \text{IsGentoo}
\end{align*}

## Questions

1. What is the estimated bill length of a Gentoo penguin with a body mass of 5000g?

\vspace{3cm}

2. What is the estimated slope on body mass, for Chinstrap penguins?
